name: Audio Workbench
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Equalizer, audio sync, channels, audio tracks and output device
description:
A six-band equalizer with presets, audio sync, normalize and crystalizer, channel selection, plus audio track switching, loading external audio files and choosing the output device.
Settings are kept across files and restarts; find it under Audio in the right-click menu and in the Audio Workbench… window.
